description: Retrieves source code for ABAP objects. For large objects, use startLine/maxLines to page through the source instead of retrieving it all at once.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to return from startLine. Omit to return the rest of the source.

startLine.description: 1-based line number to start from (default 1). Use with maxLines to page through large sources.

name: getObjectSource
